content.title: Dawn Staley's Marriage Rumors Have Always Drawn Attention
content.text: Dawn Staley, 55, has built one of the most dominant programs in college basketball history. In 18 seasons at the University of South Carolina, she has coached the Gamecocks to three national championships, reached seven Final Fours in the last 11 tournaments, and won 10 SEC regular-season titles.This season, the South Carolina Gamecocks enter the 2026 NCAA Tournament as a No. 1 seed with a 31–3 record. Despite their dominance, oddsmakers have them sitting behind the UConn Huskies, UCLA Bruins, and Texas Longhorns in the championship odds.AdvertisementOff the court, however, Staley has always been just as scrutinized, particularly around her love life, which she's never fully answered.Dawn Staley of South Carolina Gamecocks© Ken Ruinard-USA TODAY NETWORK via Imagn Images (© Ken Ruinard-USA TODAY NETWORK via Imagn Images)Staley has never been married. However, the attention around her relationship status isn’t hard to explain because the closest thing to public acknowledgment came in 2018, when Staley posted a tribute on X to longtime associate head coach Lisa Boyer.She wrote, "Boyer! We are that old married couple who started young and will grow old together. You put the ride and die in the RIDE and DIE!"AdvertisementBoyer!! We are that old married couple who started young and will grow old together. You put the ride and die in the RIDE and DIE! Proud of you Boyer. Thanks for sacrificing your career to help to me serve our teams, program, university and state. What a ride?! ❤️❤️ https://t.co/MLgYWYGbGR— dawnstaley (@dawnstaley) May 7, 2018As soon as the heartwarming tribute went viral, it led to wild rumors about their relationship. Staley, however, has never commented further despite the online noise. The two have worked together at South Carolina, where Boyer has served alongside Staley since 2008.Then, in May last year, she published her new book, “Uncommon Favor,” to share her life, career, and faith with the people who admired her throughout her coaching career. As promised, it revealed the behind-the-scenes of her successful coaching journey, including the challenges she faced.AdvertisementBut since she is not a married person yet, fans have nothing important to say about her dating life or possible marriage plans.Related: Dawn Staley, South Carolina Fail to Extend 3-Year Winning Streak After Unexpected UpsetThis story was originally published by Athlon Sports on Mar 18, 2026, where it first appeared in the College Basketball section.
